moodys.citation_text: Trinity Health of New England is a regional subsidiary of Trinity Health Corporation (MI) and rolls up to the parent's master indenture for purposes of credit ratings. No separate Moody's, S&P, or Fitch rating is published for THNE.

sp.citation_text: No separate S&P rating for THNE; rolls up to Trinity Health Credit Group (MI).

fitch.citation_text: No separate Fitch rating for THNE.
